task: GitOps daily CIS benchmark records: scheduled kube-bench run that stores per-node test records in ConfigMaps

events.summary: Add a GitOps-owned daily kube-bench (CIS 1.23) run per node in security-system that stores a per-node test record in a ConfigMap. No benchmark finding is fixed here and the portal is not changed.

The Compliance page had no positive test records: with the portal ServiceAccount, 104 of 178 framework controls were not evaluated (CIS 89 of 116) and 16 showed only 'no failure recorded'. A one-off kube-bench v0.16.0 Job on the control-plane node produced real results: PASS 74, FAIL 5, WARN 46.
evidence: test:one-off Job kube-bench run --benchmark cis-1.23 --json -> totals pass 74 fail 5 warn 46 info 0; FAIL 1.1.12, 1.2.6, 1.3.7, 1.4.2, 4.2.6

events.summary: CronJob per node rendered from the live node list (standard-library renderer), tokenless scanner container with capabilities drop ALL plus DAC_READ_SEARCH and read-only hostPaths, recorder limited to patching its own named ConfigMap, run metadata on a recorder-only volume, an error record written before the scan, Application without automated prune and generated objects annotated Prune=false,Delete=false, push-to-gitea re-renders this generated file and refuses to publish the unrendered template.

events.scope: Offline tests by the author lane and live trials by the orchestrator on the local single-node cluster on 2026-11-24. Worker-node and multi-node runs, fresh-install bootstrap and air-gap mirror delivery are not covered.
events.summary: Targeted checks pass and the scheduled job produced a complete record live. A first live run of the revised code recorded status error with reason 'scanner version mismatch' because kube-bench prints v0.16.0 while the check compared against 0.16.0; that showed the error path working and the comparison was corrected. Delivered through push-to-gitea, ArgoCD created the Application, adopted the per-node objects and left the record byte-identical; a run under ArgoCD ownership completed and the record was unchanged after a hard refresh.
evidence: test:live Job from the CronJob -> status complete, totals pass 74 fail 5 warn 46, record 40674 bytes
test:kubectl auth can-i as the recorder ServiceAccount -> patch own ConfigMap yes; other ConfigMap, create configmaps, get secrets, list pods no
test:record sha256 prefix before adoption 1ba7d0a135beb404 == after adoption 1ba7d0a135beb404

test:job after adoption -> complete 2026-11-24T12:56:20Z {'pass': 74, 'fail': 5, 'warn': 46, 'info': 0}; after hard refresh + 200s -> complete 2026-11-24T12:56:20Z {'pass': 74, 'fail': 5, 'warn': 46, 'info': 0}

events.summary: The scheduled benchmark records exist and survive GitOps publication on the single-node cluster. Not claimed: worker and multi-node behaviour, fresh-install bootstrap, air-gap mirror delivery. The image index digest was re-measured with crane on 2026-11-24T11:51:59Z and the upstream repository reports the Apache-2.0 license.
Complete and verified within the stated scope (single-node live trial plus offline tests; no benchmark finding fixed)
